title: Public Value Metrics
summary: A comprehensive introduction to public value math, examples, and reasoning, written for software engineers building for governmental and social sector organizations worldwide. Each file covers one metric or concept: definition, why it matters, the method, a worked example, the software engineering connection, pitfalls, and sources.
